shortDescription: British house prices rose 0.2% in August, leaving them 1.6% higher than a year earlier, data from mortgage lender Nationwide Building Society showed on Tuesday.A Reuters poll of economists had forecast a 0.1% monthly increase and an annual gain of 2.0%.

children: British house prices rose 0.2% in August, leaving them 1.6% higher than a year earlier, data from mortgage lender Nationwide Building Society showed on Tuesday.
